scenes.narration: In one night, Beyoncé became the most-awarded artist in Grammy history.
scenes.main_point: Open on the real 2023 photograph taped on pastel scraps with the headline and a record sticker

scenes.narration: The old record: thirty-one, set by conductor Georg Solti.

scenes.visual_objective: Count up to the old record of 31 beside the real portrait of Georg Solti and the KQED line

scenes.narration: She arrived with nine nominations. Half an hour in, Cuff It tied the record.

scenes.narration: Her fourth win, for Renaissance, broke it. Thirty-two Grammys, and a new record.
